notes.title: Changelog for version 3.6.877
notes.notes:
- setting window for offline game is now in a proper position
- better scroll list function
- updated app icons in the friend list profile page
- several other improvements and fixes

What’s new:
- Minor bugs fixed
- Server improvements

notes.title: Update 3.4.578
notes.notes:
What's new:

- The setting of online games is polished
- Some stability improvements have been made
- Minor technical updates

notes.title: Play Galaxy Trucker with the Developer!
notes.notes:
Ray and Tony, from Czech Games Edition, play Galaxy Trucker on Steam. If you own the Galaxy Trucker you can request to join their game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/870690/

Czech and Slovak Games Week discounts:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41475492-Czech-Slovak-Games-Week/sale/czskgamesweek2022

Bug fixes:
- the app no longer crashes after a few well-centered taps in the online lobby
- each push notification now opens its own target instead of launching the same game over and over
- junk-scarred veteran achievement now has a pretty colorful image after achieving it, just like the rest
- switching turns should be even smoother now

notes.title: Changes in 3.3.81
notes.notes:
- The Corporation Inc. button will no longer crash the app, nothing else stopping you from watching our awesome intro over and over again!
- Quick switch is back and you can once again jump from game to game without mid-steps
- All player nicknames are back to their beautiful colorful selves

notes.title: Bug-fix update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] It will now be much easier to check the opponents ship quickly during building.
[*] The game log now scrolls automatically to the last event (hope you won't miss all the manual scrolling).
[*] If we can't fix your connection issues, we will at least give you nicer pop-up.
[*] Cyan diplomats can no longer be cloned to multiple ships.
[*] The Junk-scarred veteran achievement will from now on, really make you face a 100 meteors instead of just 1.
[*] The hardcore achievement was deemed too frustrating and you can now win it, even if all others are replaced by AI.
[*] In the campaign mission with the Alter Ego, the tiles on its ship will no longer be invisible.
[*] Clicking the Corporation Incorporated logo, will no longer crash your app and will even show you the intro again!
[/list]

notes.title: Castle TriCon Spring 2021 and Free Weekend on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h1]Join us this weekend![/h1]
Dear Leaders and Truckers! Do you have any plans for the weekend? No? Great! We've got two exciting FREE events for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/c7464a5994c8fb3b889e3e7458e03bde7701b68e.png[/img]

[h1]Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition[/h1]
We miss you! And we miss sharing our games with you. So we came up with a solution - [url=https://www.castletricon.com]Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition[/url] - a virtual gaming convention in our unique 3D world where you can run around, explore, play demos of our board games, chat with your friends, or make new ones. [b]Completely FOR FREE![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/e2f6fca418de124ef20f1afaa1e6fdbc03450a44.gif[/img]

We are also hosting a few contests, scavenger hunts, and giveaways so you can [b]win some fantastic prizes[/b] as well (you guessed it, it’s mostly board games...but we know you love board games).

You just need to [url=https://ti.to/castletricon/spring-2021]get your free ticket[/url] and download our virtual world, and you are all set! We can't wait to see you there!

[h1]Free Weekend for CGE Digital Games[/h1]
On top of that, we are also hosting a [b]Free Weekend[/b] event here on Steam.

What is it, you ask? From February 25th, 10AM PT until March 1st, 10AM PT, you can install and play our digital games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/758370/Through_the_Ages/]Through the Ages[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/870690/Galaxy_Trucker_Extended_Edition/]Galaxy Trucker[/url] for free as well!

So if you wanted to buy them but were not sure if you would like them -- or tried to persuade your friends to try -- then now is a perfect time. You can challenge yourself and play against our AI opponents, play local games with your family and friends, or start your career as a Galaxy Trucker in our solo campaign mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34482889/6b1f6a69fd61fa28ce2d703a0ea5b298302db0b1.png[/img]

And if you like the games, you can buy them at a [b]discounted price[/b] this weekend! Oh, and be sure to visit our TriCon friends from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/horribleguild]Horrible Guild[/url], they are running a free weekend and some juicy sales as well.

Yours,
CGE Team

[h1]Exciting news – our [b]shuttles have successfully landed on Steam[/b]! Repeat, the shuttles have landed, and our brave space explorers have started colonizing computers all over this new strange land. To support these colonization efforts, [b]we’ve set up a 38% discount that will last until 14 March[/b].[/h1]

Join in, and discover a new wider Galaxy! Enjoy Galaxy Trucker on a bigger screen of your Mac or Windows :)
